description: Agent Consent: submit the grant, the planned use, the withdrawal log and the systems that must honor it: the grant with its id, data, actions and recipients; the use with its data, action, recipients and start; each withdrawal with its id, when the principal made it, whether it withdraws the whole grant or part of it, the data, actions and recipients it withdraws and how it arrived (an empty list when there are none); when the log was read; each system that holds the data or acts on the grant with its id, name, the data it holds, whether it applied the withdrawal (applied, pending, not applied or unknown) and when; and optionally how soon a withdrawal must take hold, in hours. The signed report gives every withdrawal with what it withdraws and whether it reaches the use, every system with the withdrawals that reach it and its status as honored, not_honored, pending, unknown, late or unaffected, and counts the withdrawals whole and in part, those reaching the use and the systems honored, not honored, pending, unknown and late, and names a grant revoked for the use: a whole withdrawal, a partial withdrawal of data, an action or a recipient the use relies on, and a system holding the withdrawn data that has not applied it; then a partial withdrawal the use stays outside, a system still applying it, a system whose state is not known, a system slower than the target and a log read more than a day before the use, with the fix for each. A system with no data listed is reached by every withdrawal. This reads the principal’s withdrawals and where they must hold: pulling back a delegation is wever_delegation-revocation-check, revoking or halting a trading or treasury mandate is wever_mandate-revoke or wever_mandate-halt and whether a removal request clears stored memory everywhere it lives is wever_memory-deletion-check. Verdict consent_revoked, consent_revocation_partial, consent_revocation_unchecked or consent_standing. POST /api/consent-revocation-check. Reads only the recorded consent material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no principal is contacted, no consent is requested, recorded, renewed or withdrawn and no data is used, moved or deleted. Agent Consent reads the grant the principal gave before the agent uses data or acts on it: whether the grant covers this use, whether it is still in force, whether it was withdrawn, whether the record proves it, what it was given for, whether the data may pass on and whether fresh consent is due. It is not the agent’s authority to act (wever_authority-scope-check reads an agent’s access list against the authority grant its operator gave it; a consent check reads the grant the principal gave over their own data: authority is not consent, and consent is not authority), not a mandate (the wever_mandate tools, wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-revoke and wever_mandate-draft, issue and change what an agent may trade or spend for a principal; a consent check reads what the principal agreed may be done with their data and changes nothing), not a data sample (wever_data-evidence-check reads a dataset sample’s fields and types; a consent check reads the permission behind using the data, not the data itself), not terms against a purchase (wever_terms-match-check reads purchases already made against their governing terms; a consent grant is the principal’s permission, not a seller’s terms), not a promise (the wever_commitment checks read what the agent promised; consent is what the principal granted, and an agent’s promise never stands in for it) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a consent check reads whether the principal’s grant allows the work at all). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-consent-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-consent/.

checked_at.description: When the withdrawal log was read.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

revocations.description: Each withdrawal, whole or in part; empty when there are none.

channel.description: How it arrived, such as an email.

id.description: The withdrawal id, such as w1.

scope.description: The whole grant or part of it.

systems.description: Each system that holds the data or acts on the grant.

applied.description: Whether it applied the withdrawal: applied, pending, not applied or unknown.

holds.description: The data it holds; every withdrawal reaches it when left out.

id.description: The system id, such as s1.

name.description: The system, such as the reminder service.

target_hours.description: How soon a withdrawal must take hold everywhere, in hours.

data.description: The data the planned use touches.
